t: Why should we join Pushti margh and become Vaishnav ?
x: Before talking of joining this margh and becoming Vaishnav , you need to understand the following: What is the aim / goal of a human being? To be born, to be born and to be born again and again is this the aim / goal or is it something else? Yes we are born to grow up, make good amount of money, get married, have kids, and become a business tycoon but what next? Naturally death, the inevitable truth that is unknowing always behind us. We die and take birth again, this never-ending process of life has been since ages and this never-ending process of life will never end. But this never-ending process can be stopped. How you may ask? Same thought struck in the mind of PUSHTI PURSOTAM SHRI KRISHNA and SWAMINIJI (SHRI RADHIKAJI) and then from their thoughts or rather 'Virah: Agni Swaroop Bhav', appeared a third Swaroop that is SHRI VALLABH. He was told to go to earth and end the never-ending process of birth and death. SHRI KRISHNA & SHRI SWAMINIJI had their personal dasa's and dasi's lost in this material world's maya (maya's potency is Shri Krishna himself) when they came down to earth along with SHRI KRISHNA at Mahabarata era. The Pushti Margh's main purpose is to provide Bhakti to Devi Jivas (Divine Souls / Dasa & Dasi) that were unable to join Maha-ras in Dwapar during the avtaar of Shri Krishna. Some 500 and odd years ago this third Swaroop (SHRI VALLABH) was born in Champaran, near Raipur on the eleventh day of the dark half of Chaitra Samvat 1535 or in the english year of 1479 A.D. He was named as "VALLABH"; SHRI KRISHNA also gave this name to him. SHRI VALLABH knew these human beings surrounding him are full of sins and how they can rejoin Purna-pursotam. Thinking thus, SHRI KRISHNA appeared and told Him, " VALLABH, to whom-so-ever you bless with BRAMAH: SUM-BANDH: I will never leave him.". Thus, now the road was opened to end the never-ending process of birth and death. SHRI KRISHNA (Purna-purshotam) is the main architect and designer of this margh: (Road) and SHRI VALLABH is the executioner. We people are vehicles suppose to be moving on this "PATH OF GRACE", Road of SHRI KRISHNA and SHRI VALLABH. SHRI VALLABH also known as our " GuRuDeV " wants us to drive our car (life) on this road, that will surely lead us to Purna-pursotam- SHRI KRISHNA If you want to meet Pushti Purshotam (SHRI KRISHNA) face to face and to lavishly enjoy His Lillas than you have to drive your car (life) on this margh (road). There is no other road available nor any other faith that has potency to guarantee this. Whether you accept this or not but this is it, it is SHRI KRISHNA'S personal irrevocable conditionally unconditional guarantee and no earthly or heavenly creation can deny this or challenge it. PURPORT:- 1. The Mar-Yadah: margh (path) being the margh (path) mostly worshipped by devotees of either Lord Shiva or Lord Rama or Lord Shiva's son Lord Ganesha or Lord Rama's ardent devotee Lord Hanuman or Lord Shiva's consort Durgaji but all of them at different time intervals have endosed their desire to be Blessed By Shri Giri Govardhan Thakurji Shri Krishna: 2. The Pravah (flow) margh (path) or the path of flow, which comes and goes like human life cycles. It is associated with Islam, Christanity, Judaism etc., or even Sikhism, Budhism, Jainism, they are more or less indirect Vedic Faith or rather not, but they have concepts taken from Shri Rig Ved, Shri Baghwadh Gita, Shri Manu Smiriti, Shri Shiv Puran, Shri Garg Sahita, Shri Atarva Ved, Shri Sam Ved, Shri Yajur Ved. It is nothing but deliberate Maya of Maya-pati Shiv-Shankar, Lord Shiva. Shivji did this because Lord God Shri Krishna asked him to do so. Why? To get answer why, you have to read on, this complete website. 1

t: What we have to do to drive our car (life) on this road (pushtimargh)?
x: Entry to this margh (road) is possible only: By the grace of SHRI KRISHNA, By the grace of SHRI ACHA-RIYA-CHARAN SHRI VALLABH, By the grace of SHRI YAMUNAJI, By the grace of SHRI GURU-DWAR GOSWAMI BALAKJI, By the grace of SHRI VAISHNAV. When the above grace is obtained you have the license to drive your reconditioned car (life). Here we use life as reconditioned car because you still have to purify yourself through the two rituals performed by Shri Vallabh kul Balak known as Gurudhwaar. Let us understand these rituals:- [Naam (Sha-ra-nam-mantra)]: - This first step recognizes you as a Vaishnav. This initiation is can be only performed by a descendant of Shri Vallabhacharya (Shri Vallabh kul Balak) by repeating the Mahamantra "SHRI KRISHNA SHARANAM MAMA" in the ears of the child/adult and then wearing Tulsi Mala known as Kanthi on his/her neck. Age is no limit. Your (car) is now named as Vaishnav, but without obtaining road permit you cannot drive on this road. Now to obtain road permit [Nivedan (Brahmah:sam-bandh)]: - This is must, this is the second initiation performed only by the descendant of Shri Vallabhacharya in There Haveli (temple) in front of Their Swaroop (Thakurji). Procedures to obtain road permit: You have to approach Vallabh kul balak and ask Him to grace you with Brahmah:sam-bandh and day is fixed for it. Day before the Brahmah:sam-bandh is fixed, you have to fast and then following day you have to visit His Haveli and bath there and wear new cloths ( dothi bandi for male and chanya choli and odhani / saree for female) This process is known as Ap-pras. Now you will be present in front of Thakurji where you will have two Tulsi Malas to wear and Tulsi leaves in your hands you have to recite what Shri Balak is saying these words are known a "~~GADH: MANTRA~~". Now you are vaishnav. You have to ask your GURU (BALAK) what are your duties, what ever He says you have to do it. Thus road permit is obtained. Preaching's of: Mahaprabhu Shri Vallabhacharyaji These tenets though ascribed to Pushti Path of Vallabhacharyaji are in actuality universal in nature. Hence they deserve to lead all to Divinity. 1. God, the Absolute Being is Truth; He assumes a Form or a Shape for devotees. He is Absolute Bliss. He is Omnipresent. 2. Everything that is perceived is Absolute Being. He is the creator of the Universe. The world is also Swarupa (Essential Form) of the Absolute Being. He sustains the worldly beings. 3. Hence the world is Truth, a Reality, and not merely a mirage. All the substances and the creatures of the world are various forms of God, the Absolute Being. 4. Soul is the part (Ansa) of God. Hence God is the Goal and the soul is to merge in Him. 5. Divine Love is the royal road that leads us to our Lord. 6. The first step to realize God is to cultivate love for Him in our heart. Such a heart filled with Love will soon realize The Omnipresent God permeating the creation. 7. We must dedicate everything that we receive, to our Lord. Then only, we can use it, as something bestowed upon us by Him. 8. The place where a true devotee of God starts in Seva (Service to God) is instantly transformed into the abode of our Lord Krishna (Vaikuntha). 9. Our Lord is pleased and feels contented by the selfless performance of our Dharma (Duties). 10. God is Omnipotent. He is the benefactor of all alike. 11. Everything that happens, happens as per the will of God. Have faith in Him and tolerate all miseries. 12. We must not pray or worship any human or divine being with a view to get our desires fulfilled, we must seek refuge only in God, the Absolute Being. 13. We must serve our Lord with the spontaneous flow of love for Him and without the fear of Hell or the desire for Heaven. 14. The world is the 'sports-place' of our Lord. We have also to play our part in it; and we must play it with Honesty, Sincerity of purpose and the sense of Morality. 15. There is no caste, creed, colour, sex or particular stage of life, like youth or old age, on the path of Devotion. 16. Every being holds a right to worship God. 17. Let us make our life devoted to Lord Krishna. 18. Residing in our house, we must serve Lord Krishna with both, our person and property. 19. Be useful to all, without forsaking the service to your Lord. 20. Behold God in all beings. Don't envy any one. 21. Remember and recite the name of God, as often as you can. 22. Don't hold any being either with malicious feelings or undue favour. 23. Refrain from fear and violence. 24. Serve your Lord, your Gurudeva and your fellow Vaishnavas. 25. Speak the truth, infallible. 26. In Pushtimarga (Path of Grace), even the lowest and the most down trodden person rises to the highest and the most coveted position. The humbler a man becomes, the higher are his achievements. 27. When the fire blazes brightly, it consumes every thing that is surrendered to it. Similarly, when your actions are surrendered to God, they lose their form and you are no more bound by them. 28. Learning is not achieved by mere reading or recitation of the lessons, it is the grace of Gurudeva which inspires knowledge and learning in the heart of his disciples. 29. Religion (faith) keeps only those persons pure who cling to it whole-heartedly. 30. He whose love in God survives at the time of his death survives. He is liberated. 31. Even the scripture and the words of saints fail to bring round the persons who are inclined to passions and worldly pleasures. 32. Ice and butter are melted by fire; but heart melts only by devotion. 33. God does not accept anything other than selfless love.
